description: Source manifest for the uOttawa/Telfer university pack. Official uOttawa/Telfer pages are the only acceptable source of truth for course names, program structure, co-op facts, and official club lists. Student forums may only inform qualitative wording, never facts.
source_hierarchy: 1. Official uOttawa / Telfer pages: authoritative for course names, descriptions, program structure, co-op information, official clubs.
2. Public Telfer/AÉTSA club pages: acceptable for how clubs describe their own activities and student-development value.

3. Reddit / student forums: qualitative student-experience language only (how students describe courses, common pain points). Never authoritative for requirements, prerequisites, course content, co-op rules, or policy.
4. Never used: private co-op portal content, login-only resources, LinkedIn, private student data.

sources.purpose: Source of truth for ADM course codes, English/French titles, and descriptions used in course_to_skill mappings.
sources.notes: Catalogue confirms English titles for ADM 1300, 1301, 1305, 1340, 1370, 2302 (Business Analytics for Decision Making), 2303, 2304, 2320, 2336, 2337, 2341, 2350, 2372, 2381, plus French entries ADM 1701 Gestion et société, ADM 1705 Mathématiques pour la gestion, ADM 1740 Comptabilité financière, ADM 1770 Applications des technologies de l'information en gestion (checked 2026-07-05). Remaining French pairings (ADM 1700, 27xx codes) still to_verify.

sources.source_name: Telfer School of Management — Clubs and Associations
sources.purpose: Official list of Telfer student clubs and associations for club_mappings.
sources.notes: Official page confirms (2026-07-05): AÉTSA, Accounting Club/TAC, CASCO, ACE uOttawa, Business Healthcare Society/BHS, Telfer Finance Society/TFS, Telfer Human Resources Association/HRA, TCCT, BTA, Telfer International, Enactus uOttawa, TMA, The Entrepreneurs' Club/TECDE, Women in Management Network/WMN, and UOCA. UOREC not confirmed on this page — remains to_verify.

sources.purpose: How clubs describe their activities and student-development value; cross-reference for club names/acronyms.
sources.notes: Student-facing descriptions used for club advice wording (2026-07-05): BTA (data, analytics, technology in business), TCCT (case competitions incl. JDC, HM, TICC), TMA (marketing skills, connections, personal brand), TFS (industry events, networking, mock interviews, trips), TAC (professional development, panels, workshops), CASCO (charity gala, fundraising), Enactus (social entrepreneurship), UOCA (consulting skills, firm visits, workshops), TBJ (business writing, articles). Used for descriptions and TBJ existence only — the official Telfer page remains the source of truth for the official club list.

sources.purpose: Public co-op context: number of work terms, timing, competitive admission.
sources.notes: Verified via official telfer.uottawa.ca content in search results: 3-4 paid work terms, up to 16 months, first work term after two years of study, optional and admission is competitive. No private co-op portal content is used anywhere in this project.

sources.source_name: Telfer BCom program structure / anticipated ADM course offerings
sources.purpose: Cross-reference for which ADM courses exist in the BCom program and their short titles.
sources.notes: Program sequence PDFs (e.g. ENG_BTM_2025.pdf, Finance-English.pdf) on this domain confirmed course codes and short titles used in the pack.

sources.source_name: Telfer BCom co-op sequences (BTM, Finance, Accounting, Management options)
sources.purpose: Confirms co-op variants exist for BCom options including BTM, Finance, Accounting.
sources.notes: Option-specific co-op marketing/analytics pages were not individually verified; marked to_verify.

sources.purpose: Qualitative only: how students phrase Telfer/ADM experiences on resumes (e.g. 'JDC', 'case comp', 'co-op work term'). Informs alias lists and advice tone.
sources.notes: Never used for factual claims about courses, prerequisites, co-op rules, or policy. No forum content is quoted or stored in packs.
